# WIRED

> > WIRED is a leading technology, science, culture, and business publication covering AI developments, cybersecurity, military technology, and emerging innovations.

WIRED delivers in-depth journalism on cutting-edge technology companies like Palantir and Anthropic, AI systems including Claude, defense and cybersecurity issues, product reviews, and the intersection of technology with culture and business. The site serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding how technology shapes our world.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & AI Chatbots
- Palantir
- Anthropic & Claude
- Military AI & Pentagon Technology
- Cybersecurity
- Supply Chain & Logistics
- 6G & Emerging Networks
- DOGE (Department of Government Efficiency)
- Iran & Geopolitical Technology
- Product Reviews & Tech Deals
- Social Security & Government Tech
- Flexport & Ryan Petersen
- Apple Studio Display XDR
- OpenClaw
- John Solly

## Homepage & Core Content

- [WIRED - The Latest in Technology, Science, Culture and Business](https://stag2.wired.com/): Homepage featuring tech, science, business news on Palantir, Anthropic, AI, and more
